title: Qortex DB
subtitle: Browser Key-Value Database
description: A browser-only, Redis-like key-value database with localStorage, sessionStorage, and IndexedDB support.
content: @qortex/db provides a unified async API across browser storage backends. It's simple, fast, and consistent!

callouts.title: Browser Only
callouts.content: This package is designed for browser environments only. All storage backends (localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB) are browser APIs.

sections.title: Installation
sections.content: Install @qortex/db using your preferred package manager:

code.code:
# npm
npm install @qortex/db

# yarn
yarn add @qortex/db

# pnpm
pnpm add @qortex/db

sections.title: Available Drivers
sections.content:
Choose the right storage driver for your use case:

| Driver | Persistence | Capacity | Use Case |
|--------|-------------|----------|----------|
| `local` | Permanent | ~5MB | Default, most common |
| `session` | Tab session | ~5MB | Temporary data |
| `indexedDB` | Permanent | Large | Large datasets |

sections.title: Key Features
sections.content:
- 🚀 **Unified API** - Same async interface for all storage backends
- 🔒 **Key Namespacing** - Data isolation between database instances
- 🔍 **Pattern Matching** - Find keys with wildcard patterns
- 📦 **TypeScript** - Full type inference support
- ⚡ **Tiny** - Under 3KB minified
